claim_text: 來源機構：arXiv；資料標題：From Instructional Intent to Classroom-Ready Lessons: Investigating Teacher-AI Collaboration in Lesson Authoring for Secondary Computing Education；來源刊登日：2026-10-09。作者摘要報告：研究團隊以 8 名中學運算課教師進行兩項互補的質性研究：以焦點團體探討既有的教材編寫做法，並以結構化 AI 輔助教案編寫系統 LessonBuilder 作為研究探針進行放聲思考研究；作者報告，教師的教學意圖在製作、檢視與調整教材的過程中形成，教師有選擇地把任務交給 AI，並保留判斷教材是否適合課堂使用的責任。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: From Instructional Intent to Classroom-Ready Lessons: Investigating Teacher-AI Collaboration in Lesson Authoring for Secondary Computing Education
source_locator: arXiv abs 頁 Submission history：[v1] Fri, 9 Oct 2026 00:35:00 UTC；citation_online_date 2026/10/09；Abstract；摘要歸屬：arXiv abs 頁 Abstract 第 2、3 句（arXiv API 2026-10-13 讀取）
original_excerpt: We conducted two complementary qualitative studies with eight secondary computing teachers: focus groups examining existing authoring practices and a think-aloud study using LessonBuilder, a structured AI-supported lesson authoring system, as a research probe. … We found that teachers' instructional intentions developed through creating, inspecting, and adapting materials, while teachers selectively delegated tasks to AI and retained responsibility for judging classroom readiness.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要中的對象、研究設計與作者報告的發現，不加解讀。v1 提交時戳不等於 arXiv announce 時間，預印本未經同儕審查。

summary_evidence_spans: We conducted two complementary qualitative studies with eight secondary computing teachers: focus groups examining existing authoring practices and a think-aloud study using LessonBuilder, a structured AI-supported lesson authoring system, as a research probe.

We found that teachers' instructional intentions developed through creating, inspecting, and adapting materials, while teachers selectively delegated tasks to AI and retained responsibility for judging classroom readiness.
